Definition: a Jachleelite or descendant of Jachleel
BiblicalUsage: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families, of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the family name is the point: the Jahleelites are not a man but a household, and the census counts them because the tribe was made of families, not of single names.
